photos.title: Flags at the Courthouse
photos.caption: Outside the civic complex, California and United States flags overhead, after a morning in Department 11B.
photos.alt: Man in a tan blazer over a black t-shirt standing outdoors in front of modern government buildings, with the California and United States flags on tall poles behind him.

photos.title: Waiting by 11B
photos.caption: A pause in the eleventh-floor hallway beside the red Department 11B pillar, city light at the far windows.
photos.alt: Man in a tan blazer standing in a bright courthouse hallway next to a red pillar labeled 11B Department, with a long tiled corridor and city windows behind him.

photos.title: Above the Street
photos.caption: Looking down from the high floor, tan suit against the grid of streets and rooftops below.
photos.alt: High-angle portrait of a man in a tan blazer, black t-shirt, tan trousers, and white sneakers standing by floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a city street.

photos.title: The View from Eleven
photos.caption: The city stretching out from the eleventh floor, framed by the courthouse windows.
photos.alt: View from inside a modern building through floor-to-ceiling windows onto a sunlit cityscape, road, and trees under a blue sky.
